acceptanceCriteria: A test shows no real-repository object file mtime changes after plan batches, or the spec records evidence that the change is harmless under TM-V0-008.
NTP-V0-022's known-limit text is updated to match.
body: V1-1580 (PR #1049) `corvint-tasks plan batches` runs a chained `git merge-tree --write-tree` with a throw-away GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY and the repo objects as an alternate. When a merge recreates an object that already exists, Git freshens that object's file mtime in the real repository. Content, object count and refs are unchanged; NTP-V0-022 records this as a known limit. Either prevent the freshen or prove the mtime change is harmless to the TM-V0-008 read contract and to gc/prune.
title: plan batches: dry merge-tree refreshes mtimes of pre-existing objects in the real repository (V1-1580 residual)
